run_mlm_training: run masked language model training on Habana GAI using GaudiTrainer with BERT or RoBERTa
run_mlm_from_dataset: run MLM training on a HuggingFace dataset with configurable validation split and streaming mode
run_mlm_from_file: run MLM training on local CSV, JSON, or TXT files with line-by-line or continuous tokenization
run_mlm_eval: run MLM evaluation to compute accuracy and perplexity metrics on a validation dataset
run_mlm_from_scratch: run MLM training from scratch with custom model config overrides and tokenizer settings
